Crying Cat

About

Crying Cat, also known as Sad Cat or Schmuserkadser, not to be confused with Thumbs Up Crying Cat, refers to a series of photoshopped images of cats with teary, glassy eyes to appear as though they are sad. The most common one used in memes is a photoshopped version of the Serious Cat meme (depicting a white cat) that swaps the face with a tear-eyed kitten, but most are typically used as reactions and image captions.
